youtube.title: Why You Clean Everything Except The Work (Procrastination)
youtube.description:
An invented story about a woman, an oven and a blank slide. By the end you will see what she was really cleaning away.

Maya has a talk at nine and cleans everything except the work. The film names the mechanism behind it and shows where it turns up in an ordinary week. Researchers still debate how much of procrastination is feelings and how much is planning; this is a story, not advice.
